title: Add a content library to Custom Branding
summary: Custom Branding owners can now build a **Content library**: links to their own videos, articles and podcasts, each tied to the Bible passages it covers. Anyone using that Custom Branding sees the published items in **Discover** on those chapters, grouped under the owner's own categories. Items can be added by hand, pasted in bulk or from a CSV, or found by importing a whole website from the Common Crawl web archive; imported items wait in **Needs review** until the owner publishes them.

setup.title: Open the preview build
setup.body: Use the **Open the preview build** button above, in Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox on a computer. If the page shows an error or doesn't load, the build may still be deploying: wait a few minutes and reload.

setup.title: Make sure you're seeing the new version
setup.body: The app saves a copy of itself in your browser. If anything looks like an older version, do a hard refresh: Ctrl+Shift+R on Windows, or Cmd+Shift+R on Mac.

setup.title: Sign in
setup.body: Open **Settings** (the gear icon), choose to sign in, enter your email address, then type the code that arrives in your inbox. Use an inbox you can check.

setup.title: Make a Custom Branding to test with
setup.body: Open **Your content**, press **+ Create**, then **Custom Branding**. Give it a name like `Content test` and press **Save**. Keep this editor open: the tests start from it. If you already have a Custom Branding you don't mind changing, you can use that instead.

sections.title: Creating a library and adding content by hand

tests.title: The Custom Branding editor has a Content library row
steps: In the Custom Branding editor, scroll down the list of settings rows.
expected: There is a **Content library** row with a video icon and the hint "Add your videos and articles to Discover", and an arrow on the right.

tests.title: An empty library explains itself and can be created
steps: Click **Content library**.
Read the screen, then press **Create content library**.
expected: Before creating: the title **Content library**, a heading "Put your content next to the chapters it teaches", a short explanation, and a **Create content library** button.

After pressing it: the library editor opens with "0 published · shown in Discover on 0 chapters", a **Categories** section, a **Content** section with an **Add content** button, and "Nothing here yet. Add a link and the passages it covers."
Going back to the Custom Branding editor, the row's hint now says "Your videos and articles in Discover".

tests.title: Categories can be added and removed
steps: Under **Categories**, type `Sermons` in the **New category** box and press **Add**.
Add a second category, `Kids`.
Remove `Kids` with its remove button.
expected: `Sermons` and `Kids` each appear as a category after you add them.
After removing, only `Sermons` is left.

tests.title: The passage box says which passages it understands
steps: Press **Add content**.
In **Passages it covers**, type `John 3:16; Psalm 23`.
Then change it to `John 3:16; Hezekiah 4`.
expected: With the first text, a line reads "Shows on:" followed by John 3:16 and Psalm 23.
With the second, a line reads "Not a passage we recognize: Hezekiah 4", and **Save draft** and **Publish** are greyed out.

tests.title: A link that isn't a web address is refused
steps: Still in the **Add content** form, set **Passages it covers** back to `John 3:16`.
Type `Testing` in **Title** and `example.org/video` (no `https://`) in **Link**.
Press **Publish**.
expected: The item is not added. A message says "Links must start with http:// or https://."

tests.title: Publishing an item by hand
steps: Change **Link** to `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ` (any real video or article link works).
Set **Title** to `Born again`, **Description** to `A short talk on John 3`, **Category** to `Sermons`, and **Passages it covers** to `John 3:1-21`.
Press **Publish**.
expected: You're back at the library. `Born again` is in the **Content** list marked **Published**, with John 3:1–21 shown as a passage.
The line at the top now says "1 published · shown in Discover on 1 chapters" (or "chapter").

tests.title: A draft is saved but not published
steps: Press **Add content**. Enter link `https://example.org/romans`, title `Romans draft`, and no passages.
Notice whether **Publish** is available, then press **Save draft**.
Use the **Show** filter to pick **Drafts**, then **Published**, then **All**.
expected: **Publish** stays greyed out while no passage is entered; **Save draft** works.
`Romans draft` is listed as **Draft** with "No passages yet".
The **Drafts** filter shows only `Romans draft`; **Published** shows only `Born again`; **All** shows both.

tests.title: The published item shows in Discover on its chapter
tests.before: Needs the published `Born again` item from earlier. The Custom Branding editor must still be open: while you edit it, the app uses it as if you'd opened its share link.
steps: Go to **John 3** in the reader.
Click **Discover** in the toolbar at the top.
Look for a **Sermons** filter or section, and click `Born again`.
expected: Discover has a **Sermons** filter or section that lists `Born again` with its description.
Clicking it opens a window showing the video or page.
On **John 4**, `Born again` does not appear.

tests.title: Someone opening the share link sees the content too
steps: In the Custom Branding editor, press **Share**. A message says the link was copied.
Open a private/incognito window, paste the link, and go to **John 3**.
Open **Discover**.
expected: Without signing in, the private window shows `Born again` under **Sermons** in Discover on John 3.
The draft `Romans draft` is not shown anywhere.

tests.title: Unpublishing takes the item out of Discover
steps: Back in the content library, press **Unpublish** on `Born again`.
Wait for "Updating Discover…" at the top to go away.
Reload the private window from the previous test, still on John 3, and open **Discover**.
expected: `Born again` is no longer marked **Published**, and the top line says 0 chapters.
In the private window, `Born again` no longer appears in Discover.
Press **Publish** on it again afterwards so later tests have a published item.

sections.title: Importing many links at once
sections.intro: Bulk import uses a background import service. If you can't find **Import links**, **Paste links** or **Import a website** under **Content**, the service isn't set up for the preview: mark these tests **Blocked** and say so in your notes.

tests.title: Pasted links are imported for review
steps: In the content library, under **Content**, choose **Paste links**.
In **Import links, one per line**, paste these three lines: `https://www.gotquestions.org/John-3-16.html`, `https://www.gotquestions.org/Psalm-23.html`, and `not a link`.
Press **Import links** and wait. You can watch the progress line.
expected: A message says 2 links are being imported and 1 wasn't a link and was left out.
A progress line reads like "Importing 1 of 2 · 0 failed. This keeps going if you close this page."
When it finishes, "Import finished: 2 added for review…". Both pages are in the list as **Needs review**, with titles filled in from the pages (not just the link).
Any passages the page names outright show the label "Named in the content" when you hover over or focus them.

tests.title: Importing the same links again skips them
steps: Paste the same two gotquestions.org links again and press **Import links**.
expected: A message says 2 were already in your library or listed twice. No duplicate items appear.

tests.title: Closing the page doesn't stop an import
steps: Paste 5–10 different article or video links (for example other gotquestions.org pages) and press **Import links**.
As soon as the progress line appears, close the tab.
Wait a minute, open the preview again, and go back to the Custom Branding's **Content library**.
expected: The import has carried on: either the progress line is still counting up, or it says the import finished and the new items are in the list as **Needs review**.

tests.title: An item from review can be published
steps: Use the **Show** filter to pick **Needs review**.
Open one imported item with **Edit**, check its passages (add one if it has none, e.g. `John 3:16`), and press **Publish**.
expected: The item leaves **Needs review** and shows as **Published**. It appears in Discover on its chapter, as in the earlier Discover test.

sections.title: Importing a website
sections.intro: Skip this section (mark **Blocked**) if **Import a website** isn't shown.

tests.title: Find pages needs the permission box
steps: Under **Content**, choose **Import a website**.
Type `gracechurch.org` in **Website address**, but leave the box "I own this website or have permission to list its content in Seed Bible." unticked.
expected: **Find pages** is greyed out until the box is ticked.
Typing `hello` (not a website) and pressing **Find pages** with the box ticked shows "Enter a website address, like gracecommunity.org/sermons."

tests.title: A website's archived pages are listed and can be imported
steps: Set the address to `gracechurch.org`, tick the permission box, and press **Find pages**.
Wait for the lookup to finish (it says how many lookups it has done).
Untick **Select all**, then tick just 2 or 3 pages using **Show pages** under a folder.
Press the **Import … pages** button.
expected: The lookup ends with "Found … pages" and a "From the latest crawl(s), captured … – …" line, with pages grouped into folders.
The count of selected pages and the import button's number match what you ticked.
The chosen pages import like pasted links and land in **Needs review**.
Under **Your websites**, gracechurch.org is listed with "Last imported" and today's date, and a **Check for new pages** button.

tests.title: A site the archive doesn't have says so
steps: Choose **Import a website** again, enter a made-up address such as `my-tiny-church-test-site-2026.org`, tick the box, and press **Find pages**.
expected: After the lookup, a message says Common Crawl has no pages saved from that site and that you can still paste links. Nothing is imported.

setup.title: Turn on Apologist (only if you have its key)
setup.body: These tests need the **Apologist** extension turned on under **Extensions** with its key, the same set-up as for Apologist chat. If you don't have one, mark the tests in this section **Blocked**.

tests.title: Without an agent, the library explains how to get one
tests.before: Do this before turning Apologist on, or turn it off first.
steps: In the content library, find the **AI suggestions** setting.
expected: The choice under "Suggest categories and passages with" offers "No AI: only passages named in the content", and a note says no installed agent can suggest yet and to turn one on (such as Apologist) under Extensions.

tests.title: Suggest with AI adds passages to one item
steps: Turn Apologist on with its key. Back in the content library, choose Apologist under **AI suggestions**.
On an item in **Needs review**, press **Suggest with AI** and wait.
expected: The item gains a category from your own list (e.g. `Sermons`) and/or passages. Suggested passages say "Suggested, …% sure" when you hover or focus them; unsure ones ask you to check them.
If the AI fails, the item says "The AI couldn't suggest anything for this item. Try again, or add passages yourself." and nothing else changes.

tests.title: Suggesting for every waiting item at once
tests.before: Needs two or more items in **Needs review**.
steps: Press **Suggest with Apologist for … items**.
Watch the progress line until it finishes.
expected: A line reads like "Asking Apologist: 1 of 3 · 0 failed. Keep this page open until it finishes." with a **Stop** button.
At the end it says "AI suggestions finished for … items, … failed."

tests.title: Coverage shows which chapters have content
steps: In the content library, find **Coverage**.
Press **Show by book**, then tick **Only books with gaps**.
expected: A line reads "Content on N of 1189 chapters." (or similar total), where N matches the chapters your published items cover.
Each book shows "X of Y", and John shows chapter 3 as covered. Hovering a covered chapter shows how many items it has.
**Only books with gaps** hides books whose every chapter is covered.

tests.title: Cleanup titles takes the website name off titles
steps: Check whether any imported titles end with a site name, like `… – Grace Church` or `… | GotQuestions.org`.
Press **Cleanup titles**.
expected: Titles lose the site name ("Good Things – Grace Church" becomes "Good Things"), and a message says "Cleaned up N titles".
Pressing it again says "No titles needed cleaning up".

tests.title: Rebuild index keeps Discover up to date
steps: Press **Rebuild index** and wait.
Check John 3 in Discover again.
expected: A message says "Discover is up to date".
Published items still show in Discover on their chapters, and nothing unpublished appears.

tests.title: Deleting an item asks first
steps: Press the delete button on `Romans draft`.
Press **Confirm delete**.
expected: The first press shows **Confirm delete** instead of deleting straight away.
After confirming, `Romans draft` is gone from the list.

tests.title: The content library works at phone width and in dark mode
steps: Make the browser window narrow (about the width of a phone), or open the preview on a phone.
Switch to dark mode in **Settings**.
Open the content library, the **Add content** form, and **Coverage** → **Show by book**.
expected: Nothing runs off the side of the screen, buttons are readable and tappable, and text is readable on the dark background.

tests.title: Deleting the library removes it and its content
steps: At the bottom of the content library, press **Delete library**, then **Delete library and all its content**.
Open **Discover** on John 3.
expected: The **Content library** screen goes back to "Put your content next to the chapters it teaches" with **Create content library**.
Your library's items no longer appear in Discover.

sections.title: Things that should not have changed

tests.title: Discover still works without a Custom Branding
steps: In a private/incognito window, open the preview link (not a Custom Branding link) and go to **John 3**.
Open **Discover** and click through its filters.
expected: Discover shows its usual content (cross references, study notes and so on) with no **Sermons** or **Other** sections from your library.

tests.title: The rest of the Custom Branding editor still works
steps: In the Custom Branding editor, open **Icons**, **Extensions** and a theme, then go back each time.
Change the name and press **Save**.
expected: Each screen opens and goes back normally, and the save shows "Custom Branding saved".

notCovered: Setting up and deploying the import service on Cloudflare (GitHub workflow and server settings). If bulk import isn't shown on the preview, that setup hasn't been done yet.
An import pausing when your sign-in expires partway through and continuing after you sign in again: there's no way to make a session expire on demand. Covered by automated tests.
Libraries with hundreds of items on one chapter being split into several stored parts: needs far more content than a tester would add by hand. Covered by automated tests.
CSV upload is not tested step by step; try **Upload CSV** with a file that has a `url` column if you have one handy.
The iOS and Android apps, where bulk and website import are hidden on purpose.
Removing the temporary branch line from the deploy workflow before merging.
